title: Game idea. Gang Planet.
author: alf4805
selftext:
This is an idea i've been working on and off over the years. No game development yet. I'm just trying to find tune the story to the game before i work on it. But basically this is how the game is going to be. And I'm open to ideas how to improve it more. 

It's a combination of Cyberpunk/GTA. And Star citizen. But on a smaller scale. There's only a few planets you can visit. 

The year is 2199. You are a 17 year old kid. You choose if you want to be a boy or a girl. You're tired of being lonely. Not much to do on the farm with your parents and other siblings. You want adventure. You've heard about the gangs in the other colonies on the planet.

Aurora prime is filled with them. One day you decide to leave. Your mother is okay with it. She thinks it's time for you to spread your wings. And make a name for yourself on your own terms. Your father's not too happy about it but he can't stop you. He sees how determined you are. 

He hands you the keys to the old family car. A vehicle made in the 1970s. Restored a few times over the years. 

Equipped with modern tech. The GPS units. A modern radio for music. And autopilot. The onboard AI can drive you where you want to go with limited range. 

You start out in New Vegas after driving for a few hours. Your father has contacts there. He let them know you were coming. He also told a close friend to keep an eye on you. And keep you out of trouble. Not that it helps. 

You get into a lot of trouble lol.

One of those contacts is the governor of New Vegas. 

He's an immortal. And a founder. One of the original colonists that landed on Aurora prime back in 2030. 

He takes an anti-aging drug that keeps him Young practically forever. Your father and mother are founders as well. You later find out. 

Like in cyberpunk and GTA. Multiple main missions. And multiple side missions. Crazy random encounters. Properties you can purchase. Tons of vehicles you can buy and steal lol.

Police can be bribed if you're wanted level is too high. But not every police officer can be bribed. So keep that in mind. 

A few planets within the solar system can be visited. They are colonized planets as well. You will be able to visit them as you progress through the game. 

That's all i got for now. Still tinkering with the idea. 

Like to know what you all think. And I'm up for new ideas to add.

comments.author: OrangClive44
comments.body:
Since this is AI game dev I'll be straight with you so you don't waste tokens:

1. This exists in multiple formats and games.

2. This idea is terrible.

replies.author: apotheosis_0
replies.body: No mans sky and star bound (or that mess that Bethesda put out). Theres plenty of indie games that work with this but in a more indie style like 2d, though its more of a setting than an actual open world game

comments.author: pehmeateemu
comments.body: I recommend grabbing a guidebook or two about storywriting. If you can't condense the *story* to one sentence, there is no story. What you have are plotlines, moments in the story. The story would be "A coming of age story about a teenager with wanderlust who ends up with the bad crowd and has to make the ultimate decision; remain mortal or follow the footsteps of their parents".

replies.author: alf4805
replies.body:
That's why I said it's a concept idea. I've been working on and off on it a few times over the last five years. There's more to the story but I don't want to give too much away. I don't want someone stealing what i got in mind. I've seen that happen before. I have other projects I'm working on. I just haven't had much time to flesh out the story for this one.

I have a large map in mind. 4 large cities. 7 towns. Gang rivalries. You pick a side and stick with it. Earn your reputation. And your character grows older over time in each chapter. I planned many chapters. And much more detailed story telling. Again this is just a basic concept. I plan on working on it more over time.

replies.author: pehmeateemu
replies.body:
Again, what you described is the initial setting, how the story starts and what happens along the way. If you want feedback you shouldn't be vague. 

The concept to me appears to be "An open world story-driven progressive (action?/rpg?) game". Lead with that. Action/rpg in question marks because you mentioned both GTA and Cyberpunk which are different genres. From what I see the gameplay aspects are just knockoffs from different games. 

What is your original idea / gameplay mechanic that no other game does? 

Story in itself would need to be award winning level if the gameplay is mostly a mashup of already published ideas if you are making this for someone besides yourself. 

How many characters have you written? What should the cities feel like? What are the drives and motivations of your main character? 

Seriously study storywriting, it will help you a lot because to me it seems that you are coming into this from the wrong direction.

replies.author: alf4805
replies.body:
The cities will be alive with many NPC's. You can hear them talking to each other on the streets. Many of them will have their own background stories so to speak. Each gang leader will have a detailed background. A lot of lore for those gangs. How they started out during the colonies early years. 

There will be heavy resource management once you side to a gang.

Gang names I've come up with so far. 

The Rippers. They steal people's augmentations and sell them on the black market. They also dabble in drug trafficking and other crimes. 
They are extremely Territorial and very violent. 
You don't cross them if you don't want your family finding pieces of you mailed to them. 

The Splicers. They are obsessed with genetic modification. Practically a cult of Gene editing. 
They splice themselves with animals. A favor reptiles for rapid healing capabilities.
They deal in illegal genetic modifications for a price.

The Rogues. No loyalties to any gang other than their own. They deal in all kinds of illegal activity. Drug's, vehicle theft, money laundering and so on.

The gardeners. They sell weed and nothing else. Lol. Their leader is always high as a kite lol.
They deal inside projects as well as long as it makes them money.

The city you start out in. Luna City. It looks like a nice place to live. But it's not. It has a dark side to it. A criminal underbelly. And the governor rules over it with an iron fist.

I also had ideas for mini games in the game. Such as being able to sing to any song you uploaded into it. It's can sync to your soundtrack. 
With the ability to use legacy gear. Such as using the guitar hero controller. Still working on that idea. And how to implement it into the game. 

And so many many other things I want to add into it. Such as many random events. Colorful characters. Nearly everyone you can kill. But they can have consequences. 

That's it for now. Anymore and I risk giving too much away.

replies.body: Well that is certainly one way to put it. And yes I picked that up and tried to give something constructive back nevertheless.
